blocks.prompt: 10 An RL circuit has a battery of 12 volts, a resistor of 60 Ohms, and an inductor of 2 Henries. If the circuit is closed at time \(t = 0\) with initial current zero, find the current \(I(t)\) flowing in the circuit at any time \(t\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh RL circuit ka sawal hai, bilkul Example 13 jaisa, sirf values alag hain.
Model: \(L\frac{dI}{dt} = V_S - RI\) (Section 4.1.1, Example 4 (ii)), jo Kirchhoff's voltage law se banta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(V_S = 12\), \(R = 60\), \(L = 2\), aur \(I(0) = 0\).
Find kya karna hai? Kisi bhi waqt current \(I(t)\).
Plan: values rakhein, variables alag kar ke integrate karein, initial condition lagayein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(V_S = 12\) V, \(R = 60\ \Omega\), \(L = 2\) H, \(I(0) = 0\).
Maloom karna: \(I(t)\).
Tareeqa: RL circuit model, jo separable hai; initial condition se constant aur sign dono tay honge.

Differential equation likhein
\[2\dfrac{dI}{dt} = 12 - 60I\]
\[\dfrac{dI}{dt} = 6 - 30I = 6(1 - 5I)\]
Kyun: values rakhin aur \(L = 2\) se divide kiya. Phir 6 common nikala taa ke integrate karna aasaan ho.

Variables alag karein aur integrate karein
\[\int\dfrac{dI}{1 - 5I} = \int 6\,dt\]
\[-\dfrac{1}{5}\ln|1 - 5I| = 6t + C\]
Kyun: \(1 - 5I\) ka derivative \(-5\) hai, is liye \(\int\frac{dI}{1 - 5I} = -\frac{1}{5}\ln|1 - 5I|\).
Dhyan dein: \(-\frac{1}{5}\) wala factor bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai; derivative le kar check kar lein.

\(I(0) = 0\) lagayein
\[-\dfrac{1}{5}\ln 1 = 0 + C \Rightarrow C = 0\]
Kyun: \(\ln 1 = 0\); shuru mein current zero tha.

\(I\) nikalein
\[\ln|1 - 5I| = -30t\]
\[1 - 5I = e^{-30t}\]
\[I(t) = \dfrac{1}{5}\left(1 - e^{-30t}\right)\]
Kyun: \(-5\) se multiply kiya (\(6 \times 5 = 30\)), phir \(e\) liya. \(t = 0\) par \(1 - 5I = 1\) positive hai, is liye \(+\) sign sahi hai (Example 13 ki tarah). Aakhir mein \(I\) akela kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{dI}{dt} = 6e^{-30t}\]
\[2(6e^{-30t}) + 60 \cdot \tfrac{1}{5}(1 - e^{-30t}) = 12 \;\checkmark\]
\(I(0) = 0\), aur jab \(t \to \infty\), \(I \to \frac{1}{5} = \frac{12}{60} = \frac{V_S}{R}\), yani Ohm's law wala current \(\checkmark\)
